{"metadata":{"description":"Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness)","id":"gh:1333465802","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-harness-mcp-server","slug":"chushixixin/dsh-harness-mcp-server","topics":["ai-agent","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mcp","model-context-protocol"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an MCP server (brain=Hermes, arms=Harness)"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-harness-mcp-server"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> Expose DeepSeek Harness agent capabilities as an **MCP server**, letting any MCP client (e.g. Herm"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"es) drive Harness to execute real coding tasks."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Hermes is the brain (pro), Harness is the arms (flash) — 1+1>2.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Harness ships a powerful agent runtime (tools, LLM, agents, sessions), but it is a **Cordis app**, n"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ot something another agent can call. This plugin turns Harness inside-out: it starts a real **MCP se"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"rver** (StreamableHTTP) *inside* Harness and bridges Harness's core services — `ctx.agents`, `ctx.ag"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"entPresets`, `ctx.tools` — so an external "brain" can delegate real work to Harness's "arms"."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Tools"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tool | Direction | Purpose |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `echo` | — | Verify MCP connectivity |

| `agent_run` | Hermes → Harness | Run a task synchronously and return a structured result "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"|
| `task_inbox` | Hermes → Harness | Push a structured task (task + memory context + cwd) to an asy"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"nc queue |
| `task_result` | Hermes ← Harness | Poll a queued task's structured result |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Every task result is **structured**:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"This closes the loop between the client's persistent memory and Harness's coding: memory is fed into"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" each task as `context`, and the result (`changes` / `verification` / `leftovers`) can be persisted "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"back to the client's memory for the next run."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Option A — from npm (recommended)"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Then reference the plugin from your Harness workspace (see the cordis patch below)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Option B — from source"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Clone this repo inside your Harness workspace under `packages/mcp/harness-mcp-server/` (the pnpm wor"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"kspace matches `packages/*/*`, two levels deep):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Register it in `tsconfig.host.json` references and `tsconfig.base.json` paths (see the Harness plugi"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"n docs), then build:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Run"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The MCP server listens on `127.0.0.1:8090` (StreamableHTTP). Point any MCP client at `http://127.0.0"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"r listens on `127.0.0.1:8090` (StreamableHTTP). Point any MCP client at `http://127.0.0.1:8090/mcp`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"> ⚠️ **Security**: by default the server binds to `127.0.0.1` only. Reach for this when you need **context isolation** (huge refactors that would "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"blow the client's context) or **parallel execution** of unrelated tasks."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"- The agent session is **reused per cwd** (avoids re-loading project context on every call — roughly"},{"id":"p33s2","text":" 15–20× cheaper than one-shot `dsh headless`).
